oneLine: Advent International seeks approval to acquire a stake in Yatharth Hospitals.

sources.title: Advent International seeks CCI green channel clearances for Yatharth Hospital stake buy

synopsis: Advent International's Cyprus-incorporated vehicle, Rasmalai Limited, has sought approval from the Competition Commission of India through green channel clearances to acquire a stake in Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services, an Indian super-specialty hospital chain. The transaction is currently awaiting regulatory approval, and no financial details or specific stake percentages have been disclosed in the report.
